name: Wall Gastrocnemius Stretch

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Cornell Health Lower Extremity ROM Protocol

steps: Stand facing a wall about an arm's length away and place both palms flat against the wall at shoulder height.
Step your target leg backward, keeping that back leg completely straight with the heel firmly on the ground.
Bend your front knee and gently lean your hips forward toward the wall.
Maintain the straight back leg and flat heel until you feel a comfortable stretch in the upper half of your back calf.
Hold steady for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing deeply, then switch legs.
coaching_cues: Keep your back foot pointing directly forward toward the wall; do not let your toes flare outward.
Keep your back heel glued firmly to the floor throughout the stretch.
Maintain an upright posture without slouching through your lower back.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Lower Extremity Range of Motion Protocol
